title: Character Counter
description:
Create a text input that displays the character count as the user types. This combines controlled inputs with derived state - computing values based on existing state rather than storing everything separately.

For example:
- User types 'Hi' → Shows 'Character count: 2'
- User types 'Hello' → Shows 'Character count: 5'
- User clears input → Shows 'Character count: 0'

You'll learn that not everything needs its own state - some values can be calculated from existing state.
requirements: Use React.useState to manage the text input (starting as empty string)
Render a text input that is controlled by the state
Calculate the character count from the text length
Display the count in the format: 'Character count: X'
The count should update in real-time as the user types
Export the CharacterCounter component as the default export
hints: You only need ONE state variable for the text - don't create separate state for the count
This is 'derived state' - computing values from existing state
